title: Model Zoo: choose a model and try it on your images
description: Open Model Zoo, find or download a checkpoint, inspect its details, and choose a small image set for a trial.
objectives: Open Model Zoo from Make Masks and scan a local model folder.
Choose a checkpoint and download remote weights to a model folder.
Select representative fields for a trial and find the resulting masks and quality summaries.
prerequisite: Have a local model folder or choose a downloadable catalog entry. To try a segmentation model, prepare a few TIFF, PNG, NPY or NPZ images; the Model Compare lesson includes example fields. Keep the downloaded checkpoint path for the module that will use it.

scenes.narration: From Home, open Make Masks, then choose Model Zoo. Start by finding a model for your image type. You can scan an existing model folder or download a checkpoint from the catalog.

The table lists model names, kinds and sources. Select a row to see its details. Check whether it is a segmentation model or a classifier, and choose a model whose image type and intended task match your workflow.
Click Choose folder, select your model directory, then click Scan. You can also enter the folder path directly. The table adds the local checkpoints it finds; select the file you want to use.

Read the source and availability columns to distinguish a local checkpoint from a catalog entry that still needs downloading. Use the full path in the details panel to identify your local model, especially when several files have similar names.

The details panel shows available training information, file size and checksum information. Use the recorded image and object information to judge whether the model is a suitable starting point. When information is missing, try the model on representative images before a larger run.

To obtain a remote model, select its catalog row, choose a Save to folder, then click Download. Wait for the progress to finish and keep the resulting local path. A published checksum lets the download verify the file; an entry without one requires your explicit choice to proceed.

In Test on fields, choose a small image folder and set the number of fields. Select one local segmentation model and click Test on fields. Inspect the mask previews and per-field quality summaries. To compare two local models on the same images, select both and click Compare the two selected. Use your chosen checkpoint path in the analysis module.
